doubts.claim_under_doubt: The collector and the gate agree on every wrapped .each declaration.
doubts.disproof_attempt: A wrapped .each table holding a regex literal or JSX text (e.g. [/it's/, 'x']) is not folded by the collector's table scanner, so the test stays invisible and an untagged new test passes.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISCLOSED: the collector is a separate plugin and cannot import the gate lexer; listed in the iterate spec Out of Scope.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The collector and the gate read the same native tag for a declaration.
doubts.disproof_attempt: The collector searched the whole declaration line, so a tag: [...] inside an .each table row was read as the test's own tag; the gate reads only after the title.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: FIXED: the tag array is searched only after the title; test_a_tag_inside_an_each_row_is_not_the_tests_own_tag.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: An untouched Python test digests the same on both sides.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Reordering two marks changes the digest, and several pytestmark assignments are summed instead of last-wins.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISCLOSED in the iterate spec Out of Scope.
